faqs.question: What is your standard turnaround time for a project?
faqs.answer: Typically, social media reels and short commercial ads are delivered within 3-5 business days. Larger projects like corporate videos, documentaries, or full wedding films range from 2 to 4 weeks depending on the complexity of the editing and feedback cycles.

faqs.question: Do you offer sound design and color grading separately?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer individual color grading, color correction, sound design, and motion graphics services. You can select exactly the expertise your project requires.

faqs.question: How do we collaborate on the editing revisions?
faqs.answer: We use professional review platforms (like Frame.io) where you can leave timestamped comments directly on the video. This makes revisions precise, fast, and easy for both sides.

faqs.question: Can you edit footage shot in log format (S-Log, C-Log, D-Log)?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We specialize in color-grading flat log profiles from all major camera brands (Sony, Canon, RED, ARRI, DJI) to deliver rich, luxury-grade final outputs.

blogs.title: The Art of Cinematic Color Grading: Setting the Emotional Tone
blogs.excerpt: Discover how color grading defines the psychological atmosphere of film and how luxury brands use specific palettes to convey premium status.
blogs.content: Color is the silent storyteller of cinema. It hits the viewer's subconscious long benefits they process the dialogue or the plot. In this article, we dive deep into the differences between color correction (making colors accurate) and color grading (making colors tell a story). We explore why high-end brands favor charcoal, gold, and muted pastel palettes to inspire prestige, trust, and luxury.

blogs.title: Unlocking Maximum Engagement: Editing for Social Media Reels
blogs.excerpt: Learn the scientific hook methods and pattern interrupt pacing formulas that keep viewers watching past the critical 3-second mark.
blogs.content: With attention spans shrinking to record lows, the first 3 seconds of your vertical reel determine its success. We walk through our studio's signature techniques: auto-caption animation styles, trending audio sync grids, dynamic zooming, and the 'pacing hook' that drives a 90%+ retention rate on Instagram and YouTube Shorts.
